verdicts.label: likely-bug
verdicts.rationale: Adding __slots__ changes the pickling format; objects pickled by the base version (which had a __dict__) cannot be unpickled by the head version (which expects slot storage), causing an AttributeError. The PR introduces the slots without any compatibility handling, and the change is described only as a performance tweak.
rejected: PR title: perf: add __slots__ to Marker
verdicts.facts: An object built by base from ["\"b\" > \"a\""], pickled, then unpickled by head fails to load: builtins.AttributeError.
